purpose: Test mapping granularity at fixed nominal parameter budget, learned representation contribution, semantic grouping, and information-matched federated factors.

target.status: previously used development evaluation; not a new blinded test

readout_training.features: 223 observable numeric descriptors plus 36 learned or random frozen embeddings; mean imputation, missing flags and clipping; all rows use at most current/past observations and the first20 support labels
readout_training.normalization: domain/battery-equal source training-query weights, refitted excluding each held source fold
readout_training.encoder_cv_scope: readout-level; inherited learned encoder/scaler may have seen validation source batteries
readout_training.architecture: Linear(input,160), SiLU, routing mask, scalar output weights, five true-domain intercepts
readout_training.dense_implementation: all160 units evaluated in all arms; equal dense arithmetic and trainable parameter count for capacity arms
readout_training.initial_output: zero output weights and domain intercepts; identical initial residual predictions
readout_training.selection: mean across5 source folds of domain-equal battery-macro MAE under projected output; tie takes fewer epochs; selected separately per seed/arm

semantic_group_control.implementation_refinement: Reuse the same neural head family as phase1 instead of adding a separate ridge solver; both true and pseudo groups have83205 parameters and five true-domain intercepts.
semantic_group_control.assignment: SHA256 fixed battery ranks separately for source/target; preserve true domain group counts within chemistry; no labels used
semantic_group_control.interpretation: grouping plus corresponding fixed routing policy; not an exhaustive comparison of all routing algorithms

federated_training.input: same223 numeric observables, normalized/imputed with missing indicators; trainable fresh17-input ACfC embedding36; explicit five-domain one-hot metadata supplied to every head
federated_training.encoder: same project ACfC implementation, hidden32, two cells, embedding36, per-record state reset, tau original_uniform, dt1
federated_training.head: Linear(487,32),SiLU,Linear(32,1)
federated_training.sampling: each source battery receives128 draws per local epoch with replacement from its full post20 trajectory; same per-round/client sample indices for every arm; all source trajectory positions eligible
federated_training.global_head_aggregation: client weighted in both F00 and F10; isolates encoder-aggregation factor
federated_training.domain_head_aggregation: client weighted within true domain in both F01 and F11
federated_training.hierarchy: client battery-weighted within domain, equal sources within chemistry, equal chemistries
federated_training.target_adaptation: three epochs, AdamW lr.0005 on the chosen head using20 support labels; encoder frozen; same shrinkage intercept correction as readout arms
federated_training.hyperparameters: fixed before target scoring, inherited common default choices; no target tuning and no claim of extensive per-method tuning
federated_training.security: single-process aggregation simulation without a new secure aggregation protocol
federated_training.scope: new common-information controlled model family, not a reproduction of every source-specific branch in the complete paper method
federated_training.training_scope_selection: full source trajectories for all arms, identical fixed45-round budget; no post-target checkpoint selection

evaluation.primary_postprocessing: support-last anchored cumulative minimum then clip[0,1.1]
evaluation.ensemble: three components each execute full calibration/postprocessing, then arithmetic mean
evaluation.primary_metric: battery-equal MAE and paired effects; domain-equal MAE also reported
evaluation.uncertainty: 5000 stratified paired battery bootstrap draws conditional on fixed ensemble; per-component metrics separately retained

main_method: paper_method_20shot_equal3_20261025; frozen and not replaced by these experiments
